construction: The unique root of a rational quadratic system in the stated rational box defines a normalized second-order AC subspace. Existence and uniqueness follow from an exact rational contraction certificate.
coefficientConvention: For each basis row, c_r = sqrt(binomial(15,r))*z_r, where z_r is the displayed linear expression in the unique algebraic root coordinates. Dicke basis index r=0,...,15.
verificationMethod: Banach fixed-point theorem on a closed real l_infinity box, using a rational approximate inverse Jacobian and exact Hessian bounds; symbolic full Dicke cross reductions.

fullCrossVerification.identityMethod: Each real and imaginary Dicke-splitting polynomial is an exact rational linear combination of the 14 defining equations.
